topic: Which enchanted landmark would you discover?

files.name: 01.png
files.label: MOONLIT FOUNTAIN
files.must_show: A large illuminated tiered marble fountain with a wide basin and high jets stands centrally in a moonlit stone courtyard.
files.observed_subject: A large illuminated marble fountain with a round basin and tall water jets stands in a moonlit courtyard.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: THE ICE PALACE GATE
files.must_show: A tall ornate double doorway in a crystalline ice palace dominates the frame, with steps and aurora beyond.
files.observed_subject: A large frosted double doorway is the focal point of a glowing crystalline ice palace beneath the aurora.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: THE AURORA FOUNTAIN
files.must_show: A tiered ice fountain pouring bright blue water dominates the foreground of a frozen cavern with aurora outside.
files.observed_subject: A luminous blue multi-tier ice fountain pours into a broad basin within a frozen cavern.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: THE GLASSHOUSE FOUNTAIN
files.must_show: A large three-tier stone fountain with flowing water dominates a sunlit glass-domed botanical conservatory.
files.observed_subject: A three-tier stone fountain pours water into a round pool inside a sunlit glass botanical conservatory.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: THE SAKURA BRIDGE
files.must_show: A large curved red wooden bridge spans the central foreground of a Japanese garden koi pond beneath pink cherry blossoms.
files.observed_subject: A prominent curved red wooden footbridge crosses a koi pond amid cherry blossoms and a pavilion.
